question.text: When light of frequency twice the threshold frequency is incident on the metal plate, the maximum velocity of emitted electron is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math>. When the frequency of incident radiation is increased to five times the threshold value, the maximum velocity of emitted electron becomes <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math>. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><msub><mi>v</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math>, the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> will be _____ .

solution.text:
Maximum kinetic energy is expressed as Kmax=hf-ϕ, here, ϕ is work function of metal.

For first case, 12mv12=h2f0−f0

For second case, 12mv22=h5f0−f0

⇒v22v12=41⇒v2v1=2
